data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is delighted to offer this exceptional 4-bedroom standalone villa located within the renowned Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club. Overlooking immaculate polo fields, this residence exemplifies refined living, exclusivity, and a truly elevated equestrian lifestyle.

Property Highlights:

Single Row | Standalone Villa
4 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
6 Contemporary Bathrooms
Plot Size: 6854.79 sq. ft
Unobstructed Polo Field Views
Elegant, Spacious Interior with Premium Marble Flooring
Private Pool and Private Access to Polo Fields
2 Covered Parking Spaces
2 Outdoor Parking Spaces
Generous Storage Room
Fully Furnished & Fully Equipped

Community Features & Lifestyle:

Professional Equestrian Stables & Polo Academy
2 Paddle Courts | 2 Tennis Courts
2 Swimming Pools | 2 Fully Equipped Gyms
Dedicated Pilates Studio | Luxury Spa & Wellness Centre
Golf Shooting Range | Archery Academy
Professional Football & Rugby Training Facilities
High-End Beauty Salon & Wellness Retreat
Multiple Licensed Restaurants & Elegant Lounges
Boutique Retail Outlets & Luxury Jewelry Stores
5-Stars Resort Managed by Mariott Bonvoy

This is Dubai’s only residential community centred around a fully operational international polo club and a 5-star resort. Residents benefit from direct access to world-class sporting facilities, seasonal polo tournaments, and an array of upscale amenities that create a truly unique lifestyle experience.

Whether you're an equestrian enthusiast, a discerning investor, or a family in search of an exclusive retreat, Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club offers a distinguished balance of privacy, luxury, and active community living.
